title: Churn API - Overview
description: Service health, request traffic, latency and model prediction monitoring for the Customer Churn Prediction API.

panels.title: Target Up
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the churn-api target (1 = reachable, 0 = unreachable). Alerts if the service disappears.

panels.title: Model Ready
panels.description: Gauge exported by the API indicating whether the ML pipeline is loaded and ready to serve (1 = ready, 0 = unavailable).

panels.title: Request Rate by HTTP Status Code
panels.description: Per-second rate of HTTP requests grouped by status code over the last 2 minutes. Helps detect spikes in 4xx (client errors) or 5xx (server errors).

panels.title: Error Rate 4xx
panels.description: Fraction of requests returning 4xx (client-side validation errors, e.g. 422 Unprocessable Entity) over the last 2 minutes.

panels.title: Error Rate 5xx
panels.description: Fraction of requests returning 5xx (server-side inference or unexpected errors) over the last 2 minutes. Returns 0 instead of No data when no errors occur.

panels.title: Latency /predict (p50 and p95)
panels.description: 50th and 95th percentile of end-to-end HTTP request latency for POST /predict. The p95 highlights tail latency and outliers from slow inferences.

panels.title: Predictions per Class (rate)
panels.description: Per-second rate of model predictions split by predicted churn class (Yes / No). A shift in the Yes/No ratio can signal distribution drift.

panels.title: Positive Prediction Rate (rolling 5m)
panels.description: Fraction of predictions classified as Churn=Yes over the last 5 minutes. A sustained increase may indicate distributional drift in incoming customers.

panels.title: Churn Probability Distribution
panels.description: Heatmap of raw churn prediction probability scores over time based on churn_prediction_probability_bucket.

panels.title: Decision Threshold
panels.description: Current optimal classification threshold loaded from model_metadata.json. Any change here indicates a model reload with a different threshold.

panels.title: Model Version
panels.description: Active model version label as reported by the model_info gauge. Displays the promoted champion version string.

panels.title: Alertes actives
panels.description: Table of currently firing Prometheus alerts showing alertname, severity, and active state.
